text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Just a little more!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I'm so damn close! I knew it. I'll always
be
doomed to fail at the very last
moment...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Let your tenacity carry you through!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Let your tenacity carry you through!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...! Get out of my heaaad!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, Air Shakur's lost by a nose! But
let's give it
up for the winner of this
incredible skirmish!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! What an amazing race!
This is
what the Derby's all about!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur lost by a nose, just as Parcae

predicted. The exact distance has yet to
be
announced, but if there's even the
slightest shift
in that number, then just
maybe...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ah... Man...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: This has gotta be a nightmare.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And it's the same damn one I always
have. I can't
even count how many times
I've had it...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Except this time... it's reality.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaaah...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It was all meaningless in the end...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Great, it's you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What do you want?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And what're you hollerin' f—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: 3cm差も違う。確認したから間違いない
choice_data_list_en: It's a full three centimeters off. I checked, so there's no mistake.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Are you absolutely certain?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're not just jumpin' the gun, are you?
Did you
double- and triple-check?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: 自分の目で確認もできるよ
choice_data_list_en: You can see it with your own eyes, too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Nah, I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I assumed Air Shakur wouldn't believe
what I said
until she saw the number with
her own eyes, so
this is unexpected.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I know this isn't some shoddy way of
yours to
console me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: So just drop it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A loss is a loss. I couldn't close the gap.
But...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur's hard expression loosens.
She falls
silent, as if letting the reality of
things sink in...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Now then.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I need to give Parcae the results.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Depending on what they say, there
might not be
any point in worrying over
numbers anymore.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She did mention before that changing
her fated
loss streak is more important
than getting one win
here...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
All right, it's the moment of truth. Now's
when I
find out whether or not my
nightmares continue...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur has been fiddling with her
laptop ever
since we returned to the
academy. After a few
more clicks and
taps...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The hell?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Parcae... They're givin' me an error.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No, all the other functions are workin'
fine... Hang
on, lemme run a systems
check.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I dunno what the problem is, but they
keep givin'
me an error when I try to
calculate the chances of
winning my next
race.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I've lost the ability to see how I'll do in
all of my
future races.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Good question.
choice_data_list: それって……運命が変わったってこと？
choice_data_list_en: Does that mean... fate has changed?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The fact stands that the
seven-centimeter
calculation changed. It
might be time to
acknowledge that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's not hell that awaits me now, but the
great
unknown.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't get ahead of yourself. Just 'cause I
can't
calculate the results, it doesn't
mean my terrible
fate has changed.
choice_data_list: ってことは、シニア級は……！
choice_data_list_en: Which means the Senior Year is...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Anyway, we can talk about that later.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
For all we know, this change could mean
even my
predicted win in the Kikuka Sho
might end in
humiliation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By Parcae's original prediction, Air
Shakur was set
to win the Satsuki Sho
and Kikuka Sho, making
her a Twin
Crown champion.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But if losing big is a possibility, it's also
possible
that things're gonna start
lookin' up for me...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Who knows? I could lap everyone. Not
that
there's any evidence of that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I almost can't believe it, but for the first time ever, Air Shakur actually looks excited about her future.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and summer camp's right around the
corner.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I already had a training regimen in mind,
but I
think I'll have Parcae readjust it for
me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
All the other functions work just fine. I
can still
make use of Parcae's calculation
and analysis
features. I'm in no rush to
trash them just yet.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm also on my way to meeting all the
conditions
required to win the Kikuka
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And if I surpass those target values at
summer
camp, then I might be able to
achieve even better
results than
expected.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...It's all a moot point, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So long as I don't know what's causin'
the error,
there's no way of fixin' it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(And there's still one big question. What
did that
991031021222 number mean?
Why did it
appear, and why'd it
disappear all of a sudden?)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Parcae... Are you trying to tell me
something?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ridiculous. Like they could do that.
